description: Publish a Packet to the community so others can discover and use it. Every step becomes publicly readable, so re-read the packet for keys, private endpoints or personal notes first. Requires confirm: true. Never publish on the user's behalf without them explicitly asking. Reversible with vault_unpublish, but only for future discovery — copies already taken remain.

authorName.description: Public display name. Defaults to "anonymous" — do NOT pass a wallet address unless the user asks to be identified.

confirm.description: Must be true to publish. Guards against accidental public disclosure.

name: packet_share
